0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The worried waif looks around in desperation.

25.original: Use the copper knife on the trees northwest of Gatetown to gather strips of dried bark.

26.original: Deliver the strips of dried bark to the puissant potion-maker.

27.original: Deliver the pouch of herbal pellets to the worried waif.

49.original: It's my brother─his belly hurts so much, he can't even move. I don't think the “fresh water” we bought was fresh at all...

50.original: Could you talk to the potion-maker for us, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>? I already tried, but when he started explaining the things he wanted for the medicine, I... I got scared and ran away.

51.original: The potion-maker needed something to make the medicine, but I've already forgotten what he said...

52.original: Welcome, welcome! What concoctions are you after today, then?

53.original: ...Ah, yes, I remember─the young girl and her ailing brother.

54.original: I'd used the last of my bark, you see, and all I wanted was for her to gather some from the trees on the cape. The way she ran off, you'd think I'd asked for a bowl of her blood or something...

55.original: You're welcome to collect a few strips in her stead if you like... Although I don't expect you'd want the bother.

56.original: ...Still here? Very well, then. Find some trees, and use this knife to very carefully peel away three pieces of nice, dry bark. I won't hold my breath.

57.original: All I need is three or so nicely dried strips of bark. Make sure you use that copper knife. Very important. Oh, and do bring the knife back, if you please?

58.original: Ah, I see you finally came to your senses. Let's have that knife back, then...

60.original: You actually went to harvest the bark!? But...what could you possibly hope to gain? Kindness will get you nowhere in this rotten town!

61.original: <sigh> What a rare soul you must be...<hex:02100103>I suppose I have no choice now but to mix up the cure I promised.

62.original: I've mixed some herbs and powders together with the bark you brought─a few pellets a day should soon settle the aches in the lad's stomach.

63.original: Never mind the payment. After all, it's you who's done most of the legwork.

64.original: You know, I'd hoped to trade my healing skills for a life in Eulmore, but...maybe my place is here, amongst the poor and the desperate. To help for the sake of helping, to be needed. Aye, it's not a bad feeling...

65.original: Did you go and see the potion-maker...?

66.original: ...For my brother!? Oh, thank you, <hex:020811E905FF056D697373FF076D697374657203>! You've saved his life!

67.original: You'll be wanting coin, right? Uh, I'm not sure we─

68.original: ...What do you mean, “nothing”? Here, you must take these at least─I collected them myself! Thank you again!
